sect.identity: Formal martial institution organized around shared discipline and instruction.

brotherhood_society.identity: Membership association not principally based on kinship or a formal school hierarchy.

contract_hall.identity: Covert, bounty, recovery and targeted-contract organization.

outlaw_faction.identity: Bandit, pirate, smuggling, gang or other criminal martial organization.

rule: Every persistent martial organization uses exactly one of these seven registered types. Presentation subtype never creates a separate mechanical engine.
